If you have no objection, we'll proceed as it is.
You should get ready for the operation.
Talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
如果你沒有異議，我們就按這個計劃進行。
你應該為行動做好準備。
準備好後告訴我。

scripts.text:
^0000CDThis is a memorial dungeon.^000000
Please create a party and try again.
^0000CDA party can be created using the /organize partyname command.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000CD這是一個記憶地下城。^000000
請建立隊伍並再次嘗試。
^0000CD可以使用 /organize partyname 命令建立隊伍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Shall we go?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們要走了嗎？

scripts.text: Create '{0}'.
Enter '{0}'.'

^4D4DFFThis place is a memorial dungeon.
You have to be a party leader to create a memorial dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF這是一個記憶地下城。
您必須是隊伍首領才能建立記憶地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Then, let's proceed quietly.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
那麼，讓我們悄悄行動吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's wait out a little longer before going out... We can't be careless.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
讓我們再等一會兒再出去...我們不能大意。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We handed the prisoner to Alpha.
By the way, I've prepared a trap to cause a commotion, and to catch the non-officer members.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們把囚犯交給了阿爾法。
順便說一下，我準備了一個陷阱來製造混亂，並抓獲非軍官成員。

scripts.text:
[Est]
They're not easy to catch...
Alpha is going to do some more research on the airship hangar, so go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
他們不好對付...
阿爾法還要對飛空艇機庫做進一步調查，你去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's take a break for now.
Sigh... You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
先休息一下吧。
唉...你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Oh, I'll also take the Radar.
It'll be helpful for looking for the rest of the members.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦，我還要帶上雷達。
這對尋找剩下的成員會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We're going to investigate the airship hangar.
I'm going to explain to the rest of the Rebellion first, so go ahead and take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們要去調查飛空艇機庫。
我先去跟反叛者的其他人解釋一下，你先去處理吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Can you see all the wine in here?
There is a lot of luxurious selection of wine here. Did the sage like wine?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你能看到這裡的酒嗎？
這裡有非常奢華的葡萄酒收藏。那位賢者喜歡喝酒嗎？

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
由於您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請整理您的背包後重試。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hello, guest.
I'm responsible for the airship hangar's information.
Please call me Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
您好，客人。
我負責飛空艇機庫的資訊。
請叫我艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hello, guest.
I'm responsible for the airship hangar's information.
Please call me Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
您好，客人。
我負責飛空艇機庫的資訊。
請叫我艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
After the master had destroyed this place, I have been doing something else for a while, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
在師父摧毀這裡之後，我有一段時間在做別的事情，但是...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Now I'm back at Alpha's request.
Please leave the hangar's matters to me, Elly.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
現在我是應阿爾法的請求回來的。
機庫的事情就交給我艾莉吧。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The leader of the 'intruders' had freely access the area for the master's collection 3...
I returned here to manage it.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
“入侵者”的首領曾自由出入師父的3號收藏區...
我回來是為了管理這裡。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We are currently tracking the expected path after receiving the incident report.
However, tracking it is not easy because the main system of No. 3 is completely disconnected.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
收到事故報告後，我們正在追蹤預計的路線。
但由於3號的主系統完全斷開連線，追蹤並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The 'invaders' which the 'guests' calls the 'Illusions' has a 99.9% chance that they made modifications on the system.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
“客人”們所稱的“<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺”，有99.9%的可能性對系統進行了修改。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Dear 'guests', are you here?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
親愛的“客人”，你們在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Erst]
Um, yeah. What's the big deal?
You've been having a hard time since last night.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
嗯，是的。怎麼了？
你從昨晚開始就很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I told Alpha that the analysisable data in the current state is over.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我告訴阿爾法，目前可解析的資料已經結束了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes. I have sent the data.
Currently, there is no reception from the master's collection 3, but we have caught some unusual signals.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
是的。我已經發送了資料。
目前，師父的3號收藏區沒有訊號接收，但我們捕捉到了一些異常訊號。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This facility has not been used for a long time, but it has been secretly used by the 'intruders' and...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這個設施已經很久沒用了，但被“入侵者”秘密使用過...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are traces of magical communication with certain places outside the mansion.
It's an intermittent signal.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
有與宅邸外部某些地點進行魔法通訊的痕跡。
是間歇性訊號。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
What, do they keep in touch with the outside world regularly?
Where? the enterprise?
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
什麼，他們定期與外界保持聯絡？
在哪裡？企業？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
According to the analysis, it's a one-way reception.
It appears to be collecting reports from the outside...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
根據解析，這是單向接收。
似乎是在收集外部的報告...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It will take some time to completely analyze the code because it was used by the 'intruders' for one-way reception.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
由於這是被“入侵者”用於單向接收的，完全解析程式碼需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then, Elly, I'll ask for one thing.
Continue receiving the signals as if the 'intruders' leader is still here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那麼，艾莉，我有一個請求。
請繼續接收訊號，就像“入侵者”的首領還在這裡一樣。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
That's a smart move, Rookie.
With that, we'll be able to trace back the other collaborators out there.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
這招很聰明，新人。
這樣一來，我們就能追蹤到外面那些同夥了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I will do as you say.
We will maintain information patters of the 'intruders' and collect information received from their accomplices from outside the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我會照您說的做。
我們將維持“入侵者”的通訊模式，並收集來自宅邸外部同夥的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If we're lucky, we might be able to locate the airship route that the 'Illusions' used to ran away.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果運氣好，我們也許能定位到“<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺”逃走時使用的飛空艇航線。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
So we really didn't catch the 'Illusions' here after all.
Except for that kid.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
看來我們到底還是沒能在這裡抓住“<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺”。
除了那個小孩。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We protected the mansion... Can't we be a little bit satisfied?
Tess seems to be working hard on coordinating with the companies, so that's all for us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們保護了宅邸...難道不能稍微滿意一點嗎？
泰絲似乎正在努力與公司協調，這就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As always, you did great.
We were close, but next time we'll catch the rest of them.
I've been collecting these, I'll let you have it, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
一如既往，你做得很好。
我們差一點就抓住了，下次一定能抓住剩下的。
我收集了這些，給你吧，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Erst]
I'll stay in the guest house, if you need anything, come over there.
scripts.translation:
[厄斯特]
我會住在客房，如果你需要什麼，就過來找我。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then I'll let everyone and help Alpha.
Take good care of Elly!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那麼我就去幫阿爾法。
請照顧好艾莉！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Do not worry about this place.
Me and Almond will take care of it.
You can be rest assured.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
請不要擔心這裡。
我和阿爾蒙德會處理好的。
您可以放心。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No regular signals have been received yet.
We're also tracking the whereabouts of your collection #3.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
目前還沒有收到常規訊號。
我們也在追蹤您的第3號收藏品的下落。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No worries.
Time is on our side.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
別擔心。
時間站在我們這邊。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We'll properly analyze the information, so it would be great if the guest could clean up the remnants left behind... Oh!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們會妥善解析這些資訊，所以如果客人能清理一下留下的殘骸...哦！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Just a moment, please stay here.
It'll be over soon.
Time is on our side, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
請稍等，留在這裡。
很快就會結束。
時間站在我們這邊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Wait a minute...
...
...

[Elly]
Once we decrypt the code, it'll be quick.
The longest part is over, so it feels like it went by in a flash.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
一旦破解程式碼，就會很快。
最漫長的部分已經過去了，感覺一下子就結束了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There is something in ^0000FFRachel^000000.
Of course, I've only heard of Rachel, and I've never been there.
The 'collaborators' at that location seem unaware of their leaders' movements as of yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
^0000FF拉赫^000000那裡肯定……有什麼……
當然，我只聽說過拉赫，從未去過那裡。
那裡的“同夥”似乎還不知道他們首領的行蹤。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Although we still don't know the whereabouts of Master's Collection No. 3, we need to continue to gather information coming in from here...
What should we do?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
雖然我們仍然不知道師父的第3號收藏品的下落，但我們需要繼續收集從這裡傳來的資訊...
我們該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The location of the collaborator has been roughly secured. According to the report, they are awaiting further instructions, so...
In that case, we should thoroughly investigate that area before the next instructions are given...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
同夥的位置已經大致確定。根據報告，他們正在等待進一步指示，所以...
在這種情況下，我們應該在下一條指示下達之前徹底調查那個區域...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Okay, so Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
好的，那麼拉赫...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Rachel... Who's going?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拉赫...誰去？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Are we having a difference of opinion?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們要產生分歧了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not really...
I think it would be a little awkward if we all went.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
倒也不是...
我覺得如果我們都去，可能會有點尷尬。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Ah, I see.
Yes. If the Rebellion moves, it could become a diplomatic issue.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
啊，我明白了。
是的。如果反叛者行動，可能會引發外交問題。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes, even more so if it's Rachel.
...and the problems between the mansion and the company haven't all been solved yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的，尤其是拉赫。
...而且豪宅和公司之間的問題還沒有完全解決。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
If so, then...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
如果是這樣的話...

scripts.text: Why are they looking at me?
scripts.translation: 為什麼她們都看著我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's go, Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們一起去拉赫吧。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But the other guests have affiliations, don't they?
It will be difficult if there is a conflict due to jurisdiction.
You don't know how long it will take, so it's not a good idea to accompany them.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但是其他客人都有各自的所屬，不是嗎？
如果因管轄權發生衝突會很麻煩。
不知道要花多長時間，所以不建議陪同。

scripts.text:
[Est]
That sounds like you're saying you're definitely going to go in person.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
聽起來你是一定要去親自處理。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes, it is.
Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
是的，就是這樣。
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
...

[Elly]
You're authorized.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你已獲得授權。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The purpose is not to hinder but to support.
We'll follow along, no pressure.
I will give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
目的不是阻礙，而是支援。
我們會跟隨，沒有壓力。
我把這個給你。

scripts.text:
What Elly gave was a doll that looked exactly like Elly and felt a little stretched out.
It may not be Elly, but...
scripts.translation:
艾莉給的是一個看起來和艾莉一模一樣，但感覺有點拉伸變形的玩偶。
雖然可能不是艾莉，但...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We also have equipment capable of long-distance data transmission and reception.
Because that's who we are.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們也擁有能夠進行遠距離資料傳輸和接收的裝置。
因為這就是我們的身份。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But things are a little different now, so I'll give you a beta version.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但現在情況有點不同，所以我給你一個貝塔版。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Uh... Mini Elly?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呃...迷你 艾莉？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Great, I'm adopting that name.
I can collect information like vision and hearing and communicate like an avatar using my own resources.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
很好，我就採用這個名字了。
我可以利用自身資源收集視覺和聽覺等資訊，並像化身一樣進行交流。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are no individual cores, so the information I get is not shared between betas unless I update it,
If communication is lost, it's just a puppet.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
由於沒有獨立的核心，除非我進行更新，否則我獲取的資訊不會在貝塔之間共享。
如果通訊中斷，它就只是一個傀儡。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then call us if you need our support.
I will support you without reservation, just like Elly, except for manpower.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那麼，如果你需要支援，就呼叫我們吧。
除了人力之外，我會像艾莉一樣毫無保留地支援你。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Yes, I will do that.
Please take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
是的，我會這麼做的。
請保重。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
The nearly exact coordinates of the signal's origin are...
around <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rachel,182,176,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> or so.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
訊號源的大致座標是...
在<NAVI>[這裡]<INFO>rachel,182,176,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>附近。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Safe travels to Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
祝你在拉赫一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
No intermittent signal has been received yet.
The whereabouts of the master's collection 3 are also being tracked at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
目前尚未接收到間歇性訊號。
同時也在追蹤師父的第三件收藏品的下落。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Don't worry.
Time is on our side.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
別擔心。
時間站在我們這邊。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Me and Alpha will analyze the information properly, so I'd like you to clean up the intruders remnant.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我和阿爾法會妥善解析這些資訊，所以我想請你清理一下入侵者留下的殘餘。

scripts.text: I arrived with Crux to the Prontera Palace, the palace was filled with a strange excitement.
scripts.translation: 我和克魯克斯抵達普隆德拉宮殿時，宮殿裡瀰漫著一種奇怪的興奮氣氛。

scripts.text: The people in the hall, were the royal family and nobility of the royal family who we saw before.
scripts.translation: 大廳裡的人，正是我們之前見過的王室成員和貴族。

scripts.text: At the end of the red carpet, there's a young man who's on his knees with a crown on his head.
scripts.translation: 在紅地毯的盡頭，有一位年輕男子跪在地上，頭上戴著王冠。

scripts.text: He restored his honor by regaining the glory he had lost.
scripts.translation: 他通過重獲失去的榮耀，恢復了尊嚴。

scripts.text: He who once had nothing but misery in his name.
scripts.translation: 那個曾經除了苦難之外一無所有的名字。

scripts.text: He who only saw the world, last time when he was with me.
scripts.translation: 那個上次與我在一起時，只能看到世界一面的他。

scripts.text: Wearing a crown named Glory, while his head towards the earth.
scripts.translation: 戴著名為榮耀的王冠，頭顱卻低垂向大地。

scripts.text: The moment it is declared, a new time will begin.
scripts.translation: 當那一刻被宣告，新的時代將開始。

scripts.text: My heart starts pounding hard at the fact that I'm standing in the middle of the passage of time.
scripts.translation: 意識到自己正站在時光的洪流之中，我的心開始劇烈跳動。

scripts.text: This proved the fact that the path that I've been walking is not wrong.
scripts.translation: 這證明了我所走的道路並沒有錯。

scripts.text: At the end of a long adventure, that young man standing in front of the throne, was guided by my hand.
scripts.translation: 在漫長冒險的盡頭，站在王座前的那位年輕男子，是由我的手引導至此。

scripts.text: Knowing the sorrow of the unchosen, knowing the pain of the past that cannot be reversed.
scripts.translation: 知曉未被選中者的悲傷，知曉無法逆轉的過往之痛。

scripts.text: I knew you'd stand in the way of the future, you're not assertive and knows how to seek help.
scripts.translation: 我知道你會成為未來的阻礙，你並不果斷，也不懂得尋求幫助。

scripts.text: You will be a great king.
scripts.translation: 你將成為一位偉大的國王。

scripts.text:
[Bell]
I was waiting for your return.
Where should I take you?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我一直在等您回來。
請問您要去哪裡？

scripts.text: Go out.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text:
[Bell]
I didn't expect at all that it would turn out like this.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我完全沒想到事情會變成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Bell]
Then, let us go.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
那麼，我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
What a surprise guest!
I didn't expect that we'll meet like this.
Thank you for coming despite your busy schedule.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
真是位意外的客人！
沒想到我們會這樣相遇。
感謝您百忙之中前來。

scripts.text: You look good in that.
scripts.translation: 你穿這身很好看

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I feel like I'm wearing someone else's clothes...
I'm still wondering if I can really do this.
I mean, is it really okay?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
感覺像是穿著別人的衣服...
我還在想自己真的能做到嗎。
我是說，這樣真的可以嗎？

scripts.text: You'll do well.
scripts.translation: 你會做得很好

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
If you say so, then I'll believe in you.
You'll stop me if I ever went astray someday, right?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
既然你這麼說，那我就相信你了。
如果有一天我走錯了路，你會阻止我的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe you will.
Because you're an upright person.
Also...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我相信你會的。
因為你是一個正直的人。
還有...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Feel free rest whenever you want.
After all, you're not alone.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
想休息的時候儘管休息。
畢竟，你並不孤單。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I can only see you for a moment now.
I will have to take over the king's responsibilities soon.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
現在只能和你待一會兒了。
我很快就要接手國王的職責了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
So, stay healthy, and if you ever need help someday, I will help you with all my power.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
所以，請保重身體。如果有一天你需要幫助，我會竭盡全力幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I apologize, but the bath house is currently closed due to an internal condition, and we cannot assure the reopening time. Please come back later. If you would like a quiet bath, please use the private bathroom provided with your guest room.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
抱歉，由於內部狀況，浴場目前暫停開放，且無法確定重新開放的時間。請稍後再來。如果您想安靜地沐浴，請使用客房內提供的私人浴室。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I apologize. It is Varmundt Mansion's policy to keep guests from ^0000CDdangerous situations^000000. Please wait a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
抱歉。瓦爾蒙特宅邸的政策是避免讓客人陷入^0000CD危險狀況^000000。請再稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Let's not keep to what the danger is to ourselves , please let us know.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
請不要只關注危險本身，請讓我們知道具體情況。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Sorry, we have yet to figure it out. The search is aimed at investigating the existence of risk factors. Please wait a little longer. Please understand this is a procedure.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
抱歉，我們尚未查明原因。目前的搜尋旨在調查風險因素的存在。請再稍等片刻。請理解這是必要的程式。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I repeat, you can't go in unless your safety is confirmed. I'll abide your request once I hear from my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
我再說一次，在確認安全之前，你們不能進去。等我收到同事們的訊息後，再考慮你們的請求。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We are told to cooperate with the automatic dolls of the mansion as much as possible. But if you don't move at the end, we have no choice but to use force, right?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們被告知要儘可能配合宅邸裡的自動人偶。但如果最後你們還不肯移動，我們只能採取強制手段，對吧？

scripts.text: Rookie? What's going on?
scripts.translation: 新人？怎麼回事？

scripts.text: It looks complicated, I'll just pass it by.
scripts.translation: 看起來挺複雜的，我還是算了吧。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Then, we have no choice but to call the guards.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
那麼，我們別無選擇，只能叫衛兵來了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm... What should I do with this?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...我該怎麼處理這個？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, the adventurer is here too. If you're here for a bath, I'm afraid you can't use it for a while. Look at that. The automatic doll is blocking the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，冒險者也來了。如果你是來洗澡的，恐怕暫時不能用了。你看，自動人偶正擋在入口處。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
There's a ghost coming out of here. You should watch yourself too.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
這裡有個幽靈跑出來了。你自己也要小心。

scripts.text: Ghost??
scripts.translation: 幽靈？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what it is yet. As you know, the moment we entered the mansion, everyone scattered to check the facilities.
The scout team, who went to check for possible Illusion remnants in the bathhouse, came back dead. There is ^0000CDsomething inside the bathhouse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們還不知道那是什麼。如你所知，我們一進入宅邸，大家就分散去檢查設施了。
負責檢查浴室是否有<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺殘留的偵察隊，回來時已經死了。浴室裡有^0000CD什麼東西^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I had to figure out what was really inside, whether it was the Illusion's weird prank, that's why this time ^0000CDGonie^000000 went in. It's perfect to move quietly by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我必須弄清楚裡面到底是什麼，是不是<黑暗蒐集者>的惡作劇，所以這次讓^0000CD戈尼^000000進去了。他一個人行動很安靜，正合適。

scripts.text: So why are you here...?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼在這裡...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... It's been a while since Gonie went in, but hasn't come out yet. If someone with a power like Gonie doesn't come out after the time limit, it means there is a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...戈尼進去已經有一段時間了，但還沒出來。像他那樣實力的人，如果超過時限還沒出來，就說明出問題了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'm here to follow the procedure to find out what's the dangerous something are because I'm certain there are unknown risks. We shouldn't let unknown risks interfere with our mission in this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我按照程式在這裡，是為了查明那個危險的東西到底是什麼，因為我確信存在未知的風險。我們不能讓未知的風險干擾我們在宅邸的任務。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The force that we sent in lost... We should be more careful. And as you can see, they're blocking us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們派進去的人手失聯了...我們應該更加小心。而且你也看到了，他們正在阻擋我們。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I'm sorry, but we're still searching now. When it's over please listen to the results and decide from there.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
抱歉，我們還在搜尋中。結束後請聽取結果，再作決定。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There are certain dangers in this mansion now. Whether there is more or not is a very important matter for us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
現在宅邸裡存在某些危險。是否還有更多危險，對我們來說是非常重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We need to check first if the risk is supernatural or it's the ^0000CDIllusions^000000. Can you tell me more? Maybe it's the reason the Illusion came to this mansion in the first place.
Otherwise, it's likely to fall into their hands.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們需要先確認風險是超自然的，還是^0000CD<黑暗蒐集者>^000000造成的。你能告訴我更多嗎？也許這就是<黑暗蒐集者>來到這座宅邸的原因。
否則，很可能會落入他們手中。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
I fully understand what you're trying to say. But the procedure...
Oh! The one who went to search are coming back. Talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
我完全理解你的意思。但是程式...
哦！去搜索的人回來了。去跟他們談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Wrong, you're all wrong. There's no danger.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
錯了，你們都錯了。這裡沒有危險。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
There were no guests who were said to have died. Did they really go in?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
沒有聽說有客人死亡。他們真的進去了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Were there really no missing person in there?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
裡面真的沒有失蹤人員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Maybe he ran away.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
也許他逃走了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If so, I would come back earlier. Even if it's not, I'm sure I'll get a contact from a crew, who are scattered around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果是這樣，我會早點回來的。即使不是，我也確信能聯絡到分散在宅邸各處的隊員。

scripts.text: Any guess?
scripts.translation: 有什麼猜測嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Among what you have said, the most suspicious is the action of the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
在你所說的內容中，最可疑的是入侵者的行為。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Shrine, isn't that it? The long dark green ^0000CD hair^000000. It appeared a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
神龕，難道不是嗎？那長長的深綠色^0000CD頭髮^000000。很久以前就出現過了。

scripts.text: Hair?
scripts.translation: 頭髮？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Literally as Boiler said. Since from a very long time ago, unknown hair was often found. Perhaps the hair and the unknown dangers of the bath is the same.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
正如鍋爐所說。從很久以前開始，就經常發現不明來源的頭髮。也許這些頭髮和浴室裡的未知危險是同一回事。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I think it's better to let the human guests in and search themselves.
We didn't sense the unknown danger and we failed to locate the human guests. Perhaps because we can't feel like humans do.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我覺得最好讓人類客人進去自行搜查。
我們沒有感知到未知危險，也沒能定位人類客人。也許是因為我們無法像人類那樣感知。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
You're right. Human being have senses. Maybe we'll find we missed as an automatic doll. Maybe this time we'll be able to identify whose hair is that.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你說得對。人類有感官。也許作為自動人偶，我們會發現遺漏的地方。也許這次我們能確認那頭髮是誰的。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We've heard the characteristic of the missing persons, but I'm sure the human guests are likely to recognize them better.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我們聽說了失蹤者的特徵，但我確信人類客人更有可能認出他們。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
......that makes sense. All right.
From now on, we will open the bathhouse to our guests. Please pay special attention while conducting the search, as there are circumstances and testimonies suspecting the existence of unidentified creatures.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
......這說得通。好吧。
從現在開始，我們將向客人開放浴室。請在搜查時格外注意，因為有情況和證詞懷疑存在不明生物。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you. Please let me know if you need any help finding the missing persons.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
如果你在浴室裡看到魔物，請不要貿然接觸，並告知身邊的自動人偶。如果需要幫助尋找失蹤人員，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Then, I'll take you inside.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
那麼，我帶你進去。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Well, before we enter, I'd like to ask you one thing.
The skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000 are prohibited in Meditatio, the grand bath.
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
嗯，在進入之前，我想問你一件事。
在Meditatio大浴場，禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之淚^000000等技能。
請予以理解。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
There's... you know, Lucky. Um... um... don't get me wrong. Wouldn't it be better if Lucky stays here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
那個...你知道的，拉基。嗯...嗯...別誤會。如果拉基留在這裡，會不會更好？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What are you talking about? I'm good at finding lost items. I may not be good enough for field missions, but I can atleast protect myself. You don't trust me that much?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你在說什麼？我很擅長尋找失物。我可能不夠格執行野外任務，但我至少能保護自己。你不信任我到這個地步嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No!! Lucky you're the best! The best!! You know we really can't live without Lucky! But...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
不！！拉基你是最棒的！最棒的！！你知道我們真的離不開拉基！但是...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Okay. I'll stay. Then I'll look around the entrance area. I have to check who's going in and out anyway. There's only one entrance to the bath.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧。我留下來。那我就在入口區域周圍看看。反正我得檢查誰進誰出。浴室只有一個入口。

scripts.text: I'll come with you.
scripts.translation: 我跟你一起去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It feels reassuring when the adventurer is with us.
Then, come and go <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If we find anything, we'll send a signal.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
有冒險者在身邊，我們心裡踏實多了。
那麼，請前往<NAVI>[內部]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。如果發現什麼，請發出訊號。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Go ahead <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
請前往<NAVI>[內部]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。如果在浴場內遇到魔物，請不要貿然接觸，並告知周圍的人偶。

scripts.text:
^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
^EE0000[ 注意 ]^000000
為了設施的保護與管理，Meditatio大浴場禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之淚^000000等技能。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Hello. Feel free to use the bathhouse to comfortably to relieve your fatigue.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
您好。請盡情使用浴場，舒緩您的疲勞。

scripts.text:
^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
^EE0000[ 注意 ]^000000
為了設施的保護與管理，Meditatio大浴場禁止使用^CC0000水球和天使之淚^000000等技能。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品數量過多，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的背包後重試。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Varmundt Mansion's bath house has been famous for a long time. Varmundt is a person who valued taking a rest at the end of an exhausting day.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
瓦爾蒙特宅邸的浴場早已聞名遐邇。瓦爾蒙特先生非常珍視在疲憊一天結束後休息的時光。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
He enjoyed bathing as he could relieve his fatigue, get energized for tomorrow, and organize his thoughts, and as he could improve his blood flow and replenish moisture in his skin.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
他喜歡沐浴，因為這能消除疲勞，為明天注入活力，整理思緒，還能促進血液迴圈，滋潤肌膚。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Augmenting the bath house due to his interest in various bathing methods, the bath house has expanded to today's size. The guests to the mansion have used the bath house and have praised its facilities.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
出於對各種沐浴方式的興趣，他擴建了浴場，使其發展至今日的規模。宅邸的客人們都曾使用過浴場，並對其設施讚不絕口。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Because of that, the mansion's bathhouse became very famous. I hope that you get replenished in this historic bath house.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
因此，宅邸的浴場聲名遠揚。希望您能在這座歷史悠久的浴場中恢復精力。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Please come, your party is already here.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
請過來，您的隊伍已經在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is everyone gathered? In pairs, follow the procedures for searching dangerous goods and for searching missing persons. Send a signal when you find anything, and the meeting area is in the lounge.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大家都集合好了嗎？請兩人一組，按照程式搜尋危險物品和失蹤人員。發現任何情況請發出訊號，集合地點在休息室。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We should focus on searching for the dangerous goods rather than the missing persons. The identity of the dangerous being has not yet been revealed, and various testimonies and circumstances presumed it's a humans, monster, automatic doll, and supernatural beings.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們應該優先搜尋危險物品，而不是失蹤人員。目前尚未查明危險實體的身份，根據各種證詞和情況推測，它可能是人類、魔物、自動人偶或超自然生物。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Denny and Canine. The humans are likely to be individual or groups of Illusion remnants or a third party. There is also the possibility of them using a different exit other than what is known, so check the facilities carefully.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
丹尼和卡尼恩。如果是人類，可能是<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺的殘黨或第三方勢力。也有可能是他們使用了未知的其他出口，所以請仔細檢查設施。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Cyan and Danae. Next is the monsters. Since it's a bathhouse, it's assumed that there are aquatic monsters, or something like them. So focus on the bath and pipes.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
賽安和達娜厄。接下來是魔物。既然是浴場，推測可能有水生魔物或類似生物。所以請重點檢查浴池和管道。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If it's a broken automatic doll, you know this mansion well, so you'll have to listen to the bath managers first. I'll do this one.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果是故障的自動人偶，你們很熟悉這座宅邸，所以得先聽取浴場管理員的意見。這一部分由我來負責。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Last but not the least, if it's a ghost...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
最後，但同樣重要的是，如果是幽靈...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I know!! I'll take a look! At the ceiling! and drains!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我知道！！我去看看！天花板！還有排水口！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Okay. Magenta. Go with Molar.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...好吧。瑪根塔，跟莫拉爾一起去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer meet with the other managers like me to check if there's anything suspicious about the other automatic dolls. I have to get the blueprints first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，請和我以及其他管理員會面，檢查其他自動人偶是否有可疑之處。我得先去拿藍圖。

scripts.text: Ching
scripts.translation: 叮

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I think I should start with this ^0000CDsteam^000000.
It's so blurry, I can't barely see things.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我覺得應該先從這^0000CD蒸汽^000000開始查起。
它太模糊了，我幾乎看不清東西。

scripts.text: I'll go to the Boiler Room.
scripts.translation: 我要去鍋爐房。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是嗎？我會從神龕那裡拿藍圖的。冒險者，請去<NAVI>[鍋爐房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>讓他們關閉它。我很快會趕過去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是嗎？我會從神龕那裡拿藍圖的。冒險者，請去<NAVI>[鍋爐房]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>讓他們關閉它。我很快會趕過去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I usually go on a mission alone, but this is the first time I haven't heard from him in so long. That's why everyone is looking for him anxiously. Something happened. Think about it quickly.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我通常獨自執行任務，但這是第一次這麼久沒收到他的訊息。所以大家都在焦急地尋找他。一定發生了什麼事。請快點想想。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Even if you say that, I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
就算你這麼說，我也無話可說。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hm? Adventurer? The boiler seems to have stopped, where do you plan on going?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯？冒險者？鍋爐似乎已經停了，你打算去哪裡？

scripts.text: Didn't you say that we should go to the lake?
scripts.translation: 你不是說我們要去湖邊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who? ... me? Adventurer, did you really ^0000CDsee me^000000?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰？...我？冒險者，你真的^0000CD看見我^000000了嗎？

scripts.text: Come to think of it...
scripts.translation: 仔細想想...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The tone seemed stiff and perplexed... That's definitely not me. I guess it's the unknown entity that appears in this bathhouse.
That's quite a headache. I can't believe it can mimic other people's appearance. No, in a way, it's better than that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那個語氣顯得僵硬且困惑...那絕對不是我。看來是出現在這個浴室裡的未知實體。
這真是個大麻煩。真不敢相信它能模仿別人的外貌。不，從某種意義上說，這比那更好。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Seeing that I told you to go to the lake, I think it was trying to get you out of the bathhouse somehow. So it's not a supernatural being.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然我讓你去湖邊，我想它是想設法把你引出浴室。所以它不是超自然生物。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Whatever it is, we'll have to settle it before it falls to chaos.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管它是什麼，我們必須在它陷入混亂之前解決它。

scripts.text: P-peeep-
scripts.translation: 皮-皮-

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, let's go to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，我們去<NAVI>[休息室]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Your party went to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
你的隊伍去了<NAVI>[休息室]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
How's the search for the creature going?
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
尋找生物的情況如何？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Aren't you in a middle of an operation?
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
你不在進行手術嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shrine]
Is there any inconvenience in using the bathhouse?
scripts.translation:
[神龕]
使用浴室有什麼不便之處嗎？

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品數量過多，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的背包後重試。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Uhh, human guests shouldn't just come in here. This place is not very durable.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
呃，人類客人不應該隨便進這裡。這個地方不太耐用。

scripts.text: I have something to check.
scripts.translation: 我有事要檢查。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Umm... I can't stop you. But be careful with the pipes. It'll melt your skin when you touch it in the wrong place.
But what's the point? We don't have much time.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
呃...我不能阻止你。但小心那些管道。在錯誤的地方碰到它們，會燙傷你的皮膚。
不過有什麼意義呢？我們沒有多少時間了。

scripts.text: Please shut down the boiler.
scripts.translation: 請關閉鍋爐。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Boiler? ^0000CDIt's already stopped^000000, right? That's weird. The steam is still coming out? Is the boiler not working? Look at this. I was checking it out while it's on stop.
Is it because the water hasn't cooled down yet? Anyways, I already turned the boiler off.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
鍋爐？^0000CD它已經停了^000000，不是嗎？真奇怪。蒸汽還在往外冒？是鍋爐沒工作嗎？你看這個。我在它停止的時候檢查過了。
是因為水還沒冷卻嗎？總之，我已經把鍋爐關掉了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I think this will be perfect. Oh... it's not perfect, but it's useful.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我覺得這樣應該很完美了。哦...雖然不完美，但很有用。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Have you seen this a lot on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你在來的路上經常看到這種東西嗎？

scripts.text: No, I've never seen it before.
scripts.translation: 不，我以前沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Um... I picked it up on the way here, and it looked like an automatic doll accessory. There are so many people out there that I thought they were all over the place. I was going to pick it up and repair it.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
呃...我在來的路上撿到的，看起來像是自動人偶的配件。外面人太多了，我以為到處都是。我本來打算撿起來修復一下。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
By the way, broken dolls are still appearing out of order. Why is that even if we fix broken automatic dolls, broken dolls are still appearing? Is the errors self-replicating?
I can't even clean up properly. But I have to anyway. I have to thank you.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
順便說一下，破損的人偶還在不斷出現。為什麼即使我們修復了破損的自動人偶，破損的人偶還是會出現？是錯誤在自我複製嗎？
我甚至無法徹底清理。但我必須這麼做。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
... are you not going? I already turned off the boiler. Isn't that why you came here?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
...你不走嗎？我已經把鍋爐關掉了。你來到這裡不就是為此嗎？

scripts.text: Is it an automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 那是自動人偶嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What? The monster?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
什麼？魔物？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I don't think so. Didn't you think ever think we'd notice it first, if it was?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我不這麼認為。如果它是魔物，難道你不覺得我們會先發現它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Those things out there are the work of the invaders... They want it to be like that.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
外面的那些東西是入侵者的傑作...他們希望事情是這樣的。

scripts.text: What do you think about the monster?
scripts.translation: 你覺得那個魔物是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Maybe it's the ^0000CDghost in the boiler^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
也許是^0000CD鍋爐裡的幽靈^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
The ghost. Don't you know what a ghost is? Do you know about it {0}? It's a something that died, and floats around without a physical form.
What happens here is very similar to what the ghost humans talk about.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
幽靈。你不知道什麼是幽靈嗎？你知道{0}嗎？那是死了之後，沒有實體形態而漂浮存在的東西。
這裡發生的事情，和人類所說的幽靈非常相似。

scripts.text: Then, the identity of the ghost...
scripts.translation: 那麼，幽靈的身份是...

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Um... I don't it's what you're thinking. Ah~ I thought it was a human ghost. But no, I think it was the automatic doll that used to manage this place before I even came.
It was a small bath boiler at the time, and it was often overloaded with water from so many baths. It couldn't withstand the high pressure.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
呃...我不覺得是你想的那樣。啊~我以為是人類幽靈。但不是，我覺得是那個在我來之前管理這裡的自動人偶。
當時它是個小型浴室鍋爐，經常因為太多人洗澡而超負荷。它承受不住高壓。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Anyways, it exploded while I was working on it, and the other automatic doll was burned down. Maybe it's that automatic doll.
I wonder if that doll's data was engraved in some unknown way. In this boiler.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
總之，它在我工作時爆炸了，另一個自動人偶被燒燬了。也許是那個自動人偶。
我想知道那個自動人偶的資料是否以某種未知的方式刻錄在了這個鍋爐裡。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
This boiler move sometimes on its own without anyone using it, but I think the data from the past automatic dolls remains and continues to carry out commands.
Then it makes sense to hear the sound without form and make noises. You can also see strange shapes because of the steam that comes out.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
這個鍋爐有時會自己移動，即使沒人使用它。我想這是因為過去自動人偶的資料殘留了下來，並繼續執行指令。
所以，聽到沒有實體的聲音和噪音也就說得通了。由於冒出的蒸汽，你甚至能看到奇怪的形狀。

scripts.text: That's quite scary.
scripts.translation: 那聽起來挺嚇人的。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It's scary. The valve here think it's just a boiler. Is it scary? Valve, look over here.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
確實很嚇人。這裡的閥門認為它只是個鍋爐。這很嚇人嗎？閥門，看這邊。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
Beep-
scripts.translation:
[閥門]
嗶——

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The boiler's spectre, do you think it makes sense? It's probably because of a problem that we haven't found yet. But maybe because we are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
鍋爐的幽靈，你覺得這合理嗎？這可能是因為還有我們尚未發現的問題。但也許是因為我們是自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We think that there must be something missing because we can't hear the sounds or feel the signs like the human guests.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我們認為一定有什麼缺失，因為我們無法像人類顧客那樣聽到聲音或感知跡象。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But in the end, we didn't even notice the existence of the problem. Problems that we probably won't find because of the limitations of us being a doll.
That's why I suggested to find the problem with the guests.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
但歸根結底，我們甚至沒有注意到問題的存在。由於作為人偶的侷限性，我們可能永遠無法找到這些問題。
所以我建議通過顧客來尋找問題所在。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Honestly, we didn't know what was weird because there were no customers for a long time. Not until the human guests came in, so isn't it reasonable to note the difference between humans and automatic dolls?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
老實說，因為很久沒有顧客了，我們不知道哪裡不對勁。直到人類顧客進來，所以注意人類和自動人偶之間的差異，這難道不是合理的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I heard that humans have developed senses and emotions. And the thinking ability to put it all together.
We only collect information and find a conclusion, but humans are different. I've heard you gather all personal experiences, thoughts, and imagination to come up with a conclusion.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我聽說人類發展出了感官和情感。以及將它們整合起來的思維能力。
我們只收集資訊並得出結論，但人類不同。我聽說你們會彙集所有的個人經歷、想法和想像力來得出結論。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I hope we can solve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我希望我們能解決這個問題。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Since the boiler has been turned off. Please tell the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to search freely.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
既然鍋爐已經關閉了。請告訴<NAVI>[其他顧客]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>自由搜尋。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Sweep, go meet the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. I have to keep my eyes on the boiler. If you find out anything, come here and let me know. Because I'm curious.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
斯威普，去見<NAVI>[其他顧客]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。我必須盯著鍋爐。如果你發現什麼，來這裡告訴我。因為我很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It would be better to look somewhere else than this place.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
最好去別的地方看看，而不是這裡。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What are you curious about? Do you have any questions for us?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你對什麼感到好奇？你有什麼問題要問我們嗎？

scripts.text: Boiler...
scripts.translation: 鍋爐...

scripts.text: About medicinal herbs...
scripts.translation: 關於草藥...

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Medicinal herbs? Are you curious about the herbs that is used in the bath? Why? Is the bath water not to your liking?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
草藥？你對浴池裡用的草藥感到好奇嗎？為什麼？是浴水不合你的心意嗎？

scripts.text: I really like it.
scripts.translation: 我真的很喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Is that why you came here?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
這就是你來的原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Boiler? Are you curious about the boiler? Why? Are you planning to steal the boiler?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
鍋爐？你對鍋爐感到好奇嗎？為什麼？你打算偷鍋爐嗎？

scripts.text: Steal the boiler?
scripts.translation: 偷走鍋爐？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Oh, am I wrong? The intruder was very interested in the boiler and the supply system. They stealed the other boiler without my knowledge.
But. {0} doesn't seem to be interested in it. I was just wondering if you wanted to take the boiler. If i'm wrong then nevermind.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
哦，我錯了嗎？那個入侵者對鍋爐和供水系統非常感興趣。他們趁我不注意，把另一臺鍋爐偷走了。
不過，{0}似乎對它並不感興趣。我只是在想，你是否想要拿走這臺鍋爐。如果我猜錯了，那就當我沒說。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But what will the intruder do with it? Do you think they're planning on making an open-air bath?
Hmm.. I don't really know what they could do with the boiler. Can you humans make anything out of it? Do you have an idea, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
但是，入侵者拿到它之後會做什麼呢？你覺得他們打算建一個露天浴池嗎？
嗯...我真的不知道他們能拿鍋爐做什麼。你們人類能把它做成什麼東西嗎？{0}，你有什麼想法嗎？

scripts.text: What else did they do?
scripts.translation: 他們還做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Hmmm... I liking soaking myself, but I'm more obsessed with the boiler. They seemed to be interested in the purification facility.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
嗯...我喜歡泡澡，但我更痴迷於鍋爐。他們似乎對淨化設施很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I was excited to explain about boilers. But I didn't know that they would steal it. I~ really didn't know. Is humans famous for acting on a whim?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我本來很興奮地想講解關於鍋爐的知識。但我沒想到他們會把它偷走。我~真的不知道。人類是不是以隨心所欲著稱？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
{0}, are you acting on whim too? I don't know much about humans yet. There's a lot to know. That's how I prepare. I won't let them steal it again.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
{0}，你也是隨心所欲嗎？我對人類還了解得不多。有很多東西需要學習。這就是我準備的原因。我不會再讓他們偷走了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
For example. My master says that it's cool when he soaked in the bath, but when I soaked myself. It's incredibly hot. Did I set the temperature wrong? I did, but it wasn't for him.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
比如，我的師父說泡澡時感覺很涼爽，但當我自己泡澡時，卻熱得受不了。是我設定溫度錯了？確實是我設定的，但那是為了他。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But it's cool. What does that mean? Am I mistaken?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
但是他說很涼爽。這是什麼意思？是我理解錯了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
And then. If you soak these dry leaves in hot water, the contents of the leaves comes out. But it's just that.
But somehow it's good for your health, that's why we fill every bath with herbal leaves. Do humans breath on their skins? Or do you drink water from your skins?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
還有，如果你把這些幹葉子泡在熱水裡，葉子裡的成分就會釋放出來。但僅此而已。
不知為何這對健康有益，所以我們在每個浴池裡都放入草藥葉子。人類是通過皮膚呼吸嗎？還是通過皮膚喝水？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Humans are happy to immerse themselves in the bath. Why is that?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
人類喜歡把自己浸在浴池裡。這是為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Oh, there's another one! Why do you put ground seaweed in the bath and apply the water on your face?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
哦，還有一件事！為什麼你們要把磨碎的海藻放進浴池，然後把水敷在臉上？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I was so curious that I tried it myself, but I didn't know what it was good for. Maybe because I'm an automatic doll?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我很好奇，所以自己也試了一下，但不知道那有什麼用。也許是因為我是自動人偶？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
If I had five senses like humans, I could have understand humans better. Why didn't the master gave us that?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
如果我有像人類一樣的五種感官，我就能更好地理解人類了。為什麼師父沒有給我們那種能力？

scripts.text:
[Valve]
It's all done. You have to drink now.
scripts.translation:
[閥門]
都弄好了。你現在必須喝下去。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'm not going to drink. No one's drinking.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我不喝。誰都不喝。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
Is not ready yet? Can't you just drink a little? Squeeze it out and you'll get a lot of essence.
scripts.translation:
[閥門]
還沒準備好嗎？你就不能先喝一點嗎？擠一擠就能得到很多精華。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Valve. Humans are not tea bags. Remember, I've said this many times.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
閥門。人類不是茶包。記住，我已經說過很多次了。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
All you have to do is boil the water well.
scripts.translation:
[閥門]
你只需要把水燒好就行了。

scripts.text:
[Valve]
The temperature needs to be increased to make it better.
scripts.translation:
[閥門]
需要提高溫度才能讓它變得更好。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I told you not to touch the boiler.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我說過不要碰鍋爐的。

scripts.text: - Ack! -

[Boiler]
Stop it and come over here.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
住手，過來這邊。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
It's okay because it's quiet for a while.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
沒關係，現在很安靜。

scripts.text: It looks dangerous, but the disposal...
scripts.translation: 看起來很危險，但處理...

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Why waste it! It'll still be useful if we fix it. Who am I supposed to work with if you scrap Valve? I don't like strangers.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
為什麼要浪費！修好還能用。如果你把閥門報廢了，我該跟誰一起工作？我不喜歡陌生人。

scripts.text: Why don't you fix it?
scripts.translation: 為什麼不修好它？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Because I can't leave my hands off the boiler? The intruders broke the boiler and the valves, and there was no time to fix them.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
因為我不能離開鍋爐？入侵者弄壞了鍋爐和閥門，當時沒時間修。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'm alone and the boiler room has to be ran by two, but I'm the only one left. There's no time to fix it. I can send it somewhere else, I'm worried that they'll reformat the data.
It's not so serious, I can fix it slowly. Valve is not that bad, it only touches the boiler sometimes. I don't know much about humans, but I know a lot about herbs and boilers.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
只有我一個人，但鍋爐房需要兩個人來執行，現在只剩我了。沒時間修。我可以把它送到別處，但我擔心他們會重置資料。
情況沒那麼嚴重，我可以慢慢修。閥門也沒那麼壞，它只是偶爾碰一下鍋爐。我不太懂人類，但我對草藥和鍋爐很瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
But I still have to fix it.
Hmm... {0}? Are you free?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
但我還是得修。
嗯... {0}？你有空嗎？

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
If you're free, please help me. I'm short on hands. The valve and the boiler needs to be fixed. But I'm alone and the other dolls are busy.
I wish I were two. Wow... wouldn't it be nice? If there were two of me, this would be the best boiler room.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
如果你有空，請幫幫我。我人手不足。閥門和鍋爐都需要修理。但我只有一個人，其他自動人偶都很忙。
我真希望我有兩個自己。哇...那該多好？如果有兩個我，這裡就是最棒的鍋爐房了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
I'll ask Alpha to clone me. I don't know if it's possible, but logically, it's more efficient if there's two of me.
But, what can I do right now? There's no other me. I should ask for help. So please help me if you're free.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
我會讓阿爾法克隆我。我不知道是否可行，但從邏輯上講，有兩個我更有效率。
但是，我現在能做什麼呢？沒有另一個我。我應該尋求幫助。所以如果你有空，請幫幫我。

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我來幫你。

scripts.text: I have to go take a bath.
scripts.translation: 我得去洗澡了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Really? Then there's nothing I can do. You also look tired, so I'll send you herbs for recovery. Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
真的嗎？那我無能為力了。你看起來也很累，我會給你送些恢復用的草藥。再見。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Thank you. Then, can you handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000? I also need 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
謝謝。那麼，你能處理20個^0000CD損壞的自動人偶^000000嗎？我還需要5個^0000CD損壞的自動人偶零件^000000。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Yes, then please.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
好的，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
What brings you here today? Oh, is it for work?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你今天來這裡有什麼事嗎？哦，是來工作的嗎？

scripts.text: I came to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我來打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Yes, I don't know why you are here. Nothing has changed here. We are still working on the boiler.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
是的，我不知道你為什麼在這裡。這裡沒什麼變化。我們還在修理鍋爐。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Umm... I heard humans break down easily if they work too much. Please go get some rest and come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
嗯...我聽說人類工作太累容易壞掉。請去休息一下，天亮後再回來。

scripts.text: Let me handle it.
scripts.translation: 讓我來處理。

scripts.text: I'l like to take a break today.
scripts.translation: 我今天想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
That's weird. I thought you came to see me because you want to get work, right? Well, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
真奇怪。我以為你是來找我工作的，不是嗎？好吧，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
How can there be such a sincere human? Then, today too please handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000 and bring 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
居然有如此真誠的人類。那麼，今天也請處理20個^0000CD破損的自動人偶^000000，並帶來5個^0000CD破損的自動人偶零件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Are you done with your work?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
工作做完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
在哪裡？我們需要5個破損的自動人偶零件。我覺得你的袋子有個洞。你應該檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Did you handle the 20 Broken Automatic Dolls? Are you injured somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你處理了20個破損的自動人偶嗎？你受傷了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
在哪裡？我們需要5個破損的自動人偶零件。我覺得你的袋子有個洞。你應該檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Are you done with your work?
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
工作做完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
You've brought a lot. Well, I'll trade it for this barmeal ticket. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你帶來了不少。好吧，我把它換成這張霸肋門德餐券。謝謝。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品數量過多，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的背包後重試。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's going on? See you come all the way here, are you here to look at something at the boiler?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
發生什麼事了？看到你大老遠來到這裡，你是來看鍋爐的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The boiler is already stopped. Isn't that why you're here? Shouldn't you go and report?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
鍋爐已經停了。你不是因為這個才來的嗎？你不應該去報告嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Is there anything left to see here? Didn't you have something to do?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
這裡還有什麼可看的嗎？你不是有事要做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's going on? Do we still have a story to hear? Haven't you found the all the answer for the monsters?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
發生什麼事了？我們還有故事要聽嗎？你不是已經找到了關於魔物的所有答案嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like to talk to you.
scripts.translation: 我想和你談談。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What do you want to talk about? The only thing I can talk about is cleaning. Are you curious about cleaning?
Hygiene is very important here because it's a public bath. Besides cleaning regularly everyday, I do it as often as necessary.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你想談什麼？我能談的只有清潔。你對清潔感興趣嗎？
衛生在這裡非常重要，因為這是一個公共浴室。除了每天定期清潔外，我還會根據需要隨時進行清潔。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Automatic dolls for cleaning sweeps foreign substances and dirt all over the place. This basic policy is to send all the guests out of the bathhouse when cleaning, but if the guest want to continue taking a bath, we shouldn't bother them and wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
用於清潔的自動人偶會清除各處的外來物質和汙垢。這項基本政策是在清潔時將所有客人請出浴室，但如果客人想繼續洗澡，我們不應該打擾他們，而是等待。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
However, it is not recommended that the automatic dolls that come out for cleaning should not be approached as much as possible because they are dangerous and they're for cleaning purposes only.
Actually, the cleaning dolls wasn't as strong as it is now. The measure was taken inevitably because of the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
然而，不建議接近出來進行清潔的自動人偶，因為它們很危險，且僅用於清潔目的。
實際上，清潔人偶並沒有現在這麼強大。採取這一措施是因為入侵者。

scripts.text: Because of the intruders?
scripts.translation: 因為入侵者？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you seen the intruder before? When I found them in the bath, my switch for intruder was activated, I didn't let them in. But they came by swarm and forced their way in.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你以前見過入侵者嗎？當我在浴室發現他們時，我的入侵者開關被激活了，我沒有讓他們進來。但他們成群結隊地強行闖入。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
They went through places where you can fit your body, such as water pipes and drains. The fish from the lake are also able to enter through the pipes.
Thanks to them, cleaning became more difficult. The intruder even interfered when I was cleaning. And they didn't even bother helping me clean after.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
他們通過你可以容納身體的地方，如水管和排水口。湖裡的魚也能通過管道進入。
多虧了他們，清潔變得更加困難。入侵者甚至在我清潔時進行干擾。而且他們甚至不幫忙清潔。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
This is a bathhouse. Hygiene should be the top priority. The cleaner automatic dolls are strengthened because of that.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
這是一個浴室。衛生應該是首要任務。清潔自動人偶因此得到了加強。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
The intruder took a step back however they're not completely gone yet. Therefore, the cleaner dolls had no choice but to remain the strengthened form. So be careful when coming into contact during cleaning time.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
入侵者雖然退了一步，但還沒有完全消失。因此，清潔人偶不得不保持強化形態。所以在清潔時間接觸它們時請務必小心。

scripts.text: Were you interrupted a lot?
scripts.translation: 你經常被幹擾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I don't know what the humans want.
However, humans needs to take a bath and the space to do so. The task that was given to me was cleaning. It's all I know.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我不知道人類想要什麼。
不過，人類需要洗澡，也需要洗澡的空間。我被分配的任務是清潔。我只知道這些。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
There were two groups of intruders. One was obsessed with the bath and the other one is in it's facilites. What they had in common is that they're both obsessed with something.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
入侵者分為兩組。一組痴迷於沐浴，另一組則針對設施。他們的共同點是都對某樣東西極度執著。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Humans that are obsessed with bathing did not cooperate with the cleaning, and humans obsessed with the facilities destroyed the facilites and the automatic dolls managing it.
The boiler was ripped apart and stolen, pipes were broken, and automatic dolls are dismantled. The other say they don't know how long will it take to recover from this. The situation in the other part of the mansion is not much different, the entire mansion is in this predicament.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
痴迷於沐浴的人類不配合清潔，而痴迷於設施的人類則破壞了設施以及管理它們的自動人偶。
鍋爐被拆解並偷走，管道被破壞，自動人偶也被拆解了。據說恢復原狀還需要很長時間。豪宅其他部分的情況也差不多，整個豪宅都陷入了這種困境。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What is the biggest feature that distinguish guests from the intruders? Why do guests and intruders have different behavior patterns? How do humans tell the difference between the two?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
區分客人和入侵者的最大特徵是什麼？為什麼客人和入侵者的行為模式不同？人類是如何區分這兩者的？

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
We, the automatic dolls, think it's natural that we don't know because we've only been in contact with guests before.
We can't feel things that humans can. I can't even feel the touch of the end of my hand.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我們自動人偶認為，既然之前只接觸過客人，不知道這些是很自然的。
我們無法感受人類能感受到的東西。我甚至感覺不到自己指尖的觸感。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But even if I don't know such thing, It won't impose a problem on my work. I can clean. I can carry out the task that was given to me. What is designated as trash should be swept away.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
但即使我不知道這些，也不會給我的工作帶來問題。我可以清潔。我可以執行分配給我的任務。被指定為垃圾的東西就應該被掃除。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Human beings are human beings, automatic dolls are automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
人類是人類，自動人偶是自動人偶。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
But... I'd be happy if you could help me with one thing. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
但是...如果你能幫我做一件事，我會很高興。你有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: I'd be happy to.
scripts.translation: 我很樂意。

scripts.text: I'm a little busy.
scripts.translation: 我有點忙。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I see. I understand. I learned that I should not take the time of a busy guest.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我明白了。我理解。我學到了，不應該佔用忙碌客人的時間。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000. They are one of the main cause of the miss in the bathhouse.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
那麼，請幫我消滅^0000CD15條沸騰食人魚和15條沸騰馬克^000000。它們是浴室清潔失誤的主要原因之一。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Other parts of the mansion are also lacking in hands, so we have to do it ourselves. I clean up whenever I can, but there are too many. It must not be delayed too much because it's about hygiene and safety. Then, please.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
豪宅的其他部分也人手不足，所以我們不得不自己動手。我儘量隨時清理，但數量太多了。因為這關乎衛生和安全，不能拖延太久。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
What's the matter? Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
怎麼了？你是來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text: I'm curious about cleaning.
scripts.translation: 我對清潔很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Cleaning is something I do usually. It's just difficult at the moment since there are too many obstacles.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
清潔是我平時做的事。只是現在障礙物太多，有點困難。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Um.. I'm happy that you're here to help me. But I've heard that humans need a lot of rest. Please come back again after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
嗯...很高興你能來幫我。但我聽說人類需要很多休息。請在黎明後再來。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Thank you for your help. Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
謝謝你的幫助。那麼，請幫我消滅^0000CD15條沸騰食人魚和15條沸騰馬克^000000？

scripts.text: All right.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: I'd like to take a break today..
scripts.translation: 我今天想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
I see. I've heard that humans should rest often.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
我明白了。聽說人類應該經常休息。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Then I'll let you handle it.
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
那就交給你處理了。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you dealt with it?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你處理好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Did you forgot about it? then please exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
你忘了嗎？請去消滅^0000CD15條沸騰食人魚和15條沸騰馬克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sweep]
Have you dealt with it?
scripts.translation:
[斯威普]
你處理好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boiler]
Perfect. Thank you very much. I'd be more grateful if you could come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[鍋爐]
完美。非常感謝。如果你能在黎明後再來，我會更感激的。

scripts.text:
^006600��Nameless Spring��^000000
^006600This is the place when you want to forget everything and immerse yourself into nature. However, if things are too difficult. Please come to us for assistance.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600無名之泉^000000
^006600這裡是當你想要忘卻一切，沉浸於自然中的地方。不過，如果事情太難了，請來找我們尋求幫助。^000000

scripts.text:
^006600��Footbath��^000000
^006600No need to be grand. Feel free to go and soak your feet.^000000

^006600��Fountain of Wisdom - Public Bath��^000000
^006600The oldest and most famous bath in Varmundt Mansion. Soak yourself in this bath and think about the deepest, most difficult things in your heart. The answer will surely come up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600智慧之泉 - 公共浴池^000000
^006600這是瓦爾蒙特宅邸中歷史最悠久、最著名的浴池。泡在這個浴池裡，思考你心中最深奧、最困難的問題。答案一定會浮現出來。^000000

scripts.text:
^006600��Cold Spring - Cold Bath��^000000
^0000CDSoak yourself in the cold spring if you want to be ice-cold. The cold air in the bath will bring together your disordered spirit.^000000
scripts.translation:
^006600冷泉 - 冷浴^000000
^0000CD如果你想變得冰冷，就泡在冷泉裡吧。浴池中的冷空氣會凝聚你混亂的精神。^000000

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品數量過多，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的背包後重試。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This place is dangerous.
Please come back again when you are able to protect yourself better.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這裡很危險。
請等你能夠更好地保護自己時再來。

scripts.text: - You must be atleast level 160 to perform this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你必須至少達到160級才能執行這個任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Since all places are open to special guests, we can't stop you from coming in here. However, if you're going to look around the warehouse, you shouldn't touch anything here.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
既然所有地方都對特殊客人開放，我們就不能阻止你進來。不過，如果你要在倉庫裡四處看看，請不要碰這裡的東西。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
What a mess is this.
How did you come in here?
You don't even have a key with you.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這真是亂成一團。
你是怎麼進來的？
你身上連鑰匙都沒有。

scripts.text: What's this place for?
scripts.translation: 這是做什麼的地方？

scripts.text: I don't want to cause trouble, I'll go back.
scripts.translation: 我不想惹麻煩，我回去了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Maybe you just got in accidentally.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
也許你只是誤闖進來的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
A human.
In addition... a guest?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
一個人類。
而且...還是個客人？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Did you come here to find the mansion's blueprint?
I'll bring it to you, if you can wait.
I remember the saying, that human lacks patience.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你是來這裡找宅邸的藍圖嗎？
如果你能等的話，我會把它拿來給你。
我記得有句諺語說，人類缺乏耐心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This is the second warehouse of the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這裡是瓦爾蒙特宅邸的第二倉庫。

scripts.text: Warehouse...?

[Chirp]
Oh, is there no concept of warehouse for humans outside? The warehouse is where you store things that you don't use.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
啊，外面的人類沒有倉庫這個概念嗎？倉庫就是存放不常用物品的地方。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I came here to get the mansion's blueprint and the ingredients for the restaurant. Did you come here in person because you don't trust me? If that's the case, please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我來這裡是為了取宅邸的藍圖和餐廳的食材。你是因為不信任我，所以親自來了嗎？如果是這樣的話，請不要擔心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I've been in charge of the warehouse for a very long time, I can quickly old or very small items that have been stored.
Needless to say, I also remember where the blueprint is.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我負責倉庫管理已經很久了，即使是很久以前存放的，或者非常細小的物品，我也能很快找到。
不用說，我也記得藍圖在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I'm an automatic doll. We don't lose memories.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我是自動人偶。我們不會失去記憶。

scripts.text: I'm not looking for a blueprint.
scripts.translation: 我不是來找藍圖的。

scripts.text: This place is very complicated.
scripts.translation: 這個地方很複雜。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Is that so? I misunderstood the situation.
I didn't think there would be any humans visiting the warehouse. Usually the humans that come all the way here were usually thieves.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
是嗎？我誤會了情況。
我沒想過會有人類來倉庫。通常大老遠來到這裡的人類，都是盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That doesn't mean that you are a thief. Becayse you wouldn't have qualified as a guest. The Varmundt Mansion does not invite everyone as a guest.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
但這並不意味著你是盜賊。因為你不具備成為客人的資格。瓦爾蒙特宅邸不會邀請所有人成為客人。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Even if you have that intention, it won't be easy to find what you want here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
即使你有那個意圖，在這裡找到你想要的東西也不是一件容易的事。

scripts.text: This place is very complicated.
scripts.translation: 這個地方很複雜。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Of course, it's an old warehouse of Varmundt.
It's this big now because there is not enough space to keep all items from all over the continent, that's why we constantly expanded and renovated it.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
當然，這是瓦爾蒙特的舊倉庫。
現在變得這麼大，是因為空間不足以存放來自大陸各地的所有物品，所以我們不斷地擴建和翻新。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Although it looks complex from what the eyes see, It's really not that complicated because everything is organized according to it classification.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
雖然看起來錯綜複雜，但實際上並不複雜，因為一切都按照分類整理好了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
This is only possible because it is a very large space unlike what you see outside. So if you're waiting for it, please go back and wait for me... I'll bring it to you soon.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這隻有在如此巨大的空間裡才可能做到，不像你在外面看到的那樣。所以如果你願意等的話，請回去等我...我很快就會把它拿來。

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I think I'll be delayed a little because of the broken cleaning robots. It's an automatic robot that was hacked by the intruders. I'm thinking of how to clean the mess it made.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
因為清潔機器人壞了，我可能會稍微遲到一點。那是被入侵者黑掉的自動機器人。我正在想辦法清理它造成的混亂。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
^CC0000Setting it on fire^000000 will be the cleanest way, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
^CC0000把它燒了^000000應該是最乾淨的清理方式，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text: What? Everything will be burnt.
scripts.translation: 什麼？那樣一切都會被燒掉的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That's okay. They're all fireproof. Even if it burns everything, the mansion plans are in the other warehouses. We have to go a little far, but it's fine. Rest assured.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
沒關係。它們都是防火的。即使燒掉一切，宅邸的藍圖也在其他倉庫裡。我們需要走遠一點，但沒關係。請放心。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It's fastest and cleanest to handle everything at once.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
一次性處理所有東西是最快也是最乾淨的方法。

scripts.text: That's not the problem...
scripts.translation: 問題不在於此...

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Then, what is the problem?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
那麼，問題到底出在哪裡？

scripts.text: I'd rather call the security.
scripts.translation: 我寧願叫保安來。

scripts.text: I'd rather call the superiors.
scripts.translation: 我寧願叫上級來處理。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
What do you mean by calling the superiors?
Are you telling me to leave the superiors to solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
叫上級是什麼意思？
你是想讓我把這個問題丟給上級去解決嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It would be fine to call the security, but it would take a lot of time.
Are you fine with that? Security will be in place and it will take at least a day to put them under control and deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
叫保安也可以，但那會花很多時間。
你接受嗎？保安到位後，至少需要一天才能控制局面並處理完。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It's not necessary to waste time passing a problem, when you can handle it on your own, no?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
既然自己能解決，就沒必要浪費時間把問題推給別人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
However, We are told to respect the guest's opinion as much as possible. Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
不過，我們被告知要儘可能尊重客人的意見。請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Beta]
You called? What's going on? Is it long? I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
你叫我？發生什麼事了？要很久嗎？我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Look over here. What do you think?
What do you want me to do with all the broken cleaning robots here?
Do you have a good idea?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
看這邊。你覺得怎麼樣？
這些壞掉的清潔機器人，你想讓我怎麼處理？
你有什麼好主意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Beta]
Oh. It's a serious situation.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
哦。情況很嚴重啊。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Right? Now, tell me how to solve it quickly.
For the human guest here to hear. Because the guest wants me to call you here for another solution.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
對吧？現在，告訴我怎麼快速解決。
讓這位人類客人聽聽。因為客人想讓我叫你過來尋求另一個解決方案。

scripts.text:
[Beta]
The problem is not only in this place. There's no security that I can send here right now.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
問題不僅僅在這裡。我現在沒有可以立刻派過去的保安。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I need to get something for the guest here right now. If I go in there now, will I end up broken just like them? Is that fine?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我現在需要為這裡的客人取點東西。如果我現在進去，會不會像它們一樣壞掉？這樣沒關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[Beta]
You can't do that, but I can't help you. I'll send you help as soon as possible. But not until tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
你不能那樣做，但我幫不了你。我會盡快派人支援。但要等到明天。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Can I start a fire?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我可以放火嗎？

scripts.text:
[Beta]
No. Don't. The broken robot will just move to another place.
Also, we can't risk our guests into such thing.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
不行。別那樣做。壞掉的機器人只會轉移到別的地方。
而且，我們不能讓客人冒這種風險。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I'm confident that I can keep the fire from spreading.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我有信心能控制火勢，不讓它蔓延。

scripts.text:
[Beta]
You can't. The more you delay me like this, the slower the process it gets. Wait a little longer. And ask the guest's for their understanding.
scripts.translation:
[貝塔]
你做不到。你這樣拖延，處理過程只會更慢。再等一會兒。並請客人諒解。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Have you seen it? Even if I call my superior, there's no help that will come right now. I can't even proceed with my solution of starting a fire anymore. I could have started it, if you didn't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你看到了嗎？即使我叫了上級，現在也沒有人會來幫忙。我甚至不能再執行我的放火方案了。如果你沒跟我說話，我本來可以點火的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
What should I do now? There's something I need to get from over there, and If I went there, I'll end up broken just like them. I'm not a combat type doll after all.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我現在該怎麼辦？我需要去那邊取點東西，但如果我去了，就會像它們一樣壞掉。畢竟我不是戰鬥型人偶。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I can avoid them to some extent, but I'm worried because there are too many of them. If they attacked all at once, even the strongest dolls will be destroyed in no time.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我可以一定程度上避開它們，但數量太多了，我很擔心。如果它們一起攻擊，即使是最強的人偶也會瞬間被摧毀。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Of course, I can go sacrifice myself for this request.
But, I don't think that's not the choice right now. It would be more valuable if I sacrifice myself for something more important.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
當然，我可以為這個請求犧牲自己。
但我認為現在不是時候。如果為了更重要的事情犧牲自己，我的價值會更大。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Besides, who else would manage the warehouse?
No one even knows what's where.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
而且，還有誰去管理倉庫呢？
沒人知道東西放在哪裡。

scripts.text: Should I sort it out?
scripts.translation: 我來整理一下？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
{0}, Are you sure?
Are you saying that you're going to sort out those cleaning robots?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
{0}，你確定嗎？
你是說你要去整理那些清潔機器人？

scripts.text: Can't I do it?
scripts.translation: 我不能做嗎？

scripts.text: You look troubled.
scripts.translation: 你看起來很煩惱。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Are you showing pity to me for being helpless in front of the automatic doll in the warehouse? Do humans feel responsible for things they didn't do?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你是在可憐我在倉庫的自動人偶面前無能為力嗎？人類會對他們沒有做過的事情感到有責任嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Is the fault of one human, the fault of all human?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
一個人類的過錯，就是所有人類的過錯嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Is that so? That's why we've misunderstood. They're all connected, so they share everything. Both blame and responsiblity.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
是嗎？這就是我們產生誤解的原因。它們都是相連的，所以共享一切。無論是責備還是責任。

scripts.text: Varmundt is also human.
scripts.translation: 瓦爾蒙特也是人類。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
He's different. He's a wise man.
If he's here now, he would have solve all the problems. Or maybe the problem itself didn't occur.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
他不一樣。他是個智者。
如果他現在在這裡，他就能解決所有問題。或者也許問題本身就不會發生。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Thank you for your help, but there was a notice telling to cooperate with the guests as much as possible without causing you harm. I'll think of another way. Anything will do.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
謝謝你的幫助，但告示上說要在不傷害客人的前提下儘可能配合客人。我會想別的辦法。任何辦法都行。

scripts.text: I'm a combatant.
scripts.translation: 我是戰鬥人員。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
... Is that so? If you're a combatant, you're job is to deal with these kind of things, isn't it? Wouldn't that hurt you?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
...是嗎？如果你是戰鬥人員，你的工作就是處理這類事情，不是嗎？這不會傷害到你嗎？

scripts.text: Not at all.
scripts.translation: 一點都不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I see, you're a human being who finds pleasure with these kind of things. I've heard of it before. Then I'd like to ask you a favor. Oh, of course, I'll reward you for it.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我明白了，你是個從這類事情中獲得樂趣的人。我以前聽說過。那麼我想請你幫個忙。哦，當然，我會給你獎勵的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Please collect ^0000CDFive Cleaning Robot^000000.
Then I'll be able to get through this mess.
I hope you find pleasure on it.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
請收集^0000CD五個清潔機器人^000000。
這樣我就能度過這個難關了。
希望你能從中找到樂趣。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Are you done? There are still too many of them. I need you to work harder.
Please collect ^0000CDFive Cleaning Robot^000000.
Then I'll be able to get through this mess.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你完成了嗎？還有太多。我需要你更努力。
請收集^0000CD五個清潔機器人^000000。
這樣我就能度過這個難關了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Did you enjoy it? I wonder if you get pleasure from destroying it or pleasure from conservation, But I don't have to know that.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你玩得開心嗎？我不知道你是從破壞中獲得樂趣，還是從保護中獲得樂趣，但這不重要。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Thanks to you, I was able to retrieve the stuffs that we need.
At that level, you can move your body faster than normal.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
多虧了你，我才能取回我們需要的東西。
在那個層面上，你的身體移動速度比平時更快。

scripts.text: - Rumbling -
scripts.translation: - 隆隆聲 -

scripts.text: - Rattling -
scripts.translation: - 嘎吱聲 -

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你聽到了嗎？

scripts.text: Is that a rattling sound?
scripts.translation: 那是嘎吱聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Yes, that's right. Stay still, and be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
是的，沒錯。保持靜止，保持安靜。

scripts.text: - Rattling -
scripts.translation: - 嘎吱聲 -

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It's the sound made by an automatic doll based on the voice pattern. But it's not a sound of an automatic dolls near here. It's a little bit far from here.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這是根據聲音模式發出的自動人偶的聲音。但這不是附近自動人偶發出的聲音，距離這裡有點遠。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I think it's from the basement. If it's really from the basement, it's a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我覺得是從地下室傳來的。如果真的是從地下室傳來的，那就大事不妙了。

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Unlike this warehouse, only Varmundt can enter the basement. There are a lot of secrets and dangerous thing there.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
與這個倉庫不同，只有瓦爾蒙特能進入地下室。那裡有很多秘密和危險的東西。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
If automatic dolls or human go in and mess with a dangerous object by mistake.
A foreseeable destruction will surely occur.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
如果自動人偶或人類進去，不小心弄壞了危險物品。
必然會發生可預見的毀滅。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
If this is really from the underground, and that's a sound of an automatic doll, only destruction awaits us.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
如果這真的是從地下傳來的，而且是自動人偶的聲音，那麼等待我們的只有毀滅。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It's only a matter of time before this place becomes ash from the massive explosion. It's a different level from my plan to set it on fire.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
這個地方變成灰燼只是時間問題，源於巨大的爆炸。這比我計劃中的縱火要嚴重得多。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
There's danger lurking underground.
Someone has to check it. If you check what happened, we might be able to ask your superiors to come soon. Then It'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
地下潛伏著危險。
必須有人去檢查。如果你去檢視發生了什麼，我們也許能請求你的上級儘快趕來。那樣就沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
We need to do something to stop this.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我們必須做點什麼來阻止這一切。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I have to go pick up the blueprint and ingredients while the broken automatic dolls is organized.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
在整理損壞的自動人偶期間，我得去取藍圖和材料。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
{0} is a combatant.
So the rest is...
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
{0}是戰鬥人員。
所以剩下的...

scripts.text: ...to go and check it.
scripts.translation: ...去檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Oh, you would? That's unexpected.
I can't believe you don't do this much security job. I'll keep that in mind. Taking care of guest's entertaiment is one of our job.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
哦，你願意嗎？真沒想到。
我簡直不敢相信你會做這麼多安保工作。我會記住的。照顧客人的娛樂也是我們的工作之一。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
There'a stairway that goes underground in the ^0000CDuppermost part of the warehouse^000000. Go down stairs and check the situation below. Don't touch anything there.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
在^0000CD倉庫的最上層^000000有一條通往地下的樓梯。走下樓梯，檢查下面的情況。不要碰那裡的任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Go ahead and come back when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
去吧，完成後回來。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
There'a stairway that goes underground in the ^0000CDuppermost part of the warehouse^000000. Go down stairs and check the situation below. Don't touch anything there.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
在^0000CD倉庫的最上層^000000有一條通往地下的樓梯。走下樓梯，檢查下面的情況。不要碰那裡的任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Have you checked? What's the situation underground?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你檢查過了嗎？地下的情況如何？

scripts.text: It's locked.
scripts.translation: 鎖住了。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Was it locked? But how did the automatic doll go in? That's even a bigger problem. This proves that there is a hole in the security of the mansion, the intruders also entered through as passage other than the only entrance.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
門鎖著？那自動人偶是怎麼進去的？這更成問題了。這證明莊園的安全系統有漏洞，入侵者也是通過除了唯一入口以外的通道進來的。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It would be a good idea to check it... You said it was locked. I can't force myself to get in, I need to find the emergency key.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
最好檢查一下... 你說門鎖著。我不能強行進去，我需要找到備用鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
It was only for the master, but after going down to the basement, the master left an emergency key that can only be used if something goes wrong with the master or a dangerous emergency.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
那是專門給師父準備的，但師父去地下室後，留下了一把備用鑰匙，只有在師父出事或發生危險緊急情況時才能使用。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That would be know a dangerous emergency.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
那肯定就是危險的緊急情況了。

scripts.text: Give it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Do you like treasure hunt? Or do you have an exceptional talent for treasure hunting? If not, I hope you'll have it from now on.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你喜歡尋寶嗎？或者你有尋寶的特殊天賦？如果沒有，我希望你從現在開始擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
The master hid a ^0000CDtotal of three emergency keys in the warehouse^000000. And there is still a lot of broken automatic dolls in here.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
師父在倉庫裡藏了^0000CD總共三把備用鑰匙^000000。而且這裡還有很多損壞的自動人偶。

scripts.text: That means...
scripts.translation: 也就是說...

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
That's right. It's time for you to have fun again. I'm glad to help you like this again.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
沒錯。是時候讓你再玩一次了。很高興能再次這樣幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
You can go down to the basement by finding all the emergency keys at the hints that I'll point out. Use it to unlock the door that goes down to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
你可以通過我提示的線索找到所有備用鑰匙，然後去地下室。用它來開啟通往地下室的門。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
<NAVI>[Spinning World]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. He said all the truth is beneath it. Try to find a place with such an item.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
<NAVI>[旋轉世界]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。他說所有的真相都在下面。試著找一個有這種物品的地方。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
He also said that in a <NAVI>[place]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where your breath freezes, everything is said to remain unchanged forever.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
他還說，在<NAVI>[那個地方]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，你的呼吸會凍結，據說那裡的一切永遠保持不變。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Lastly, he said that all air must be hollow. He also said that it uses a lot of energy. I can't even guess where <NAVI>[such a place]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
最後，他說所有的空氣必須是空洞的。他還說那裡消耗很多能量。我甚至猜不出<NAVI>[那樣的地方]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I don't know what all the hints mean, but you adventurer are a human like our master. You might be interpret them.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我不知道這些線索是什麼意思，但你們冒險者和我們師父一樣是人類。也許你能解讀它們。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
I don't expect you to interpret even a single line of the great master's will, but... If you don't know, you can just go search everywhere. Then go ahead and come back.
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
我不指望你能解讀偉大師父的意志，但... 如果你不知道，就到處找找吧。然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Chirp]
Oh, I forgot to tell you this.
The warehouse is very dangerous, so you have to be very careful. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[啾啾]
哦，我忘了告訴你這個。
倉庫非常危險，所以你必須非常小心。好嗎？
